decisions.name: Sustained, distinctive narrating voice
decisions.audit_reason: A distinctive, consistent narrative voice is a core craft property, not surface form or fingerprint.

decisions.name: Earned Payoff
decisions.audit_reason: A prepared, meaningful ending is a classic craft and structure quality criterion.

decisions.name: Form That Serves Content
decisions.audit_reason: Explicitly judges whether chosen form serves meaning versus is decorative -- a genuine craft assessment.

decisions.name: Prompt enacted through consequence, not recited
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether the prompt's idea is dramatized through consequence rather than recited -- a craft measure.

decisions.name: Causal Escalation
decisions.audit_reason: Escalating stakes and consequence across beats is a standard plot-structure quality criterion.

decisions.name: Emotional payoff earned by prior stakes-building
decisions.audit_reason: Whether stakes are built before an emotional beat lands is a dramaturgical craft judgment.

decisions.name: The story refuses to gloss itself
decisions.audit_reason: Subtlety -- letting meaning land unstated -- is a genuine craft judgment, not surface form.

decisions.name: Embodied Scene Presence
decisions.audit_reason: Show-don't-tell sensory concreteness versus abstract summary is a standard literary quality dimension.

decisions.name: Earned idea payoff from the premise
decisions.audit_reason: Whether the story develops a genuine implication of its premise is a substantive quality judgment.

decisions.name: Distinctiveness of central conceit
decisions.audit_reason: Judges originality/surprise of the central idea versus stock convention -- a creativity/quality criterion.

decisions.name: Dynamic Power in Relationships
decisions.audit_reason: Dialogue and action revealing shifting relational power is a genuine characterization craft skill.

decisions.name: Economy of Explanation
decisions.audit_reason: Judges whether exposition is handled through selective, inferential craft versus redundant telling.

decisions.name: Self-contained: no borrowed affect from outside the text
decisions.audit_reason: Whether emotional effect is self-contained versus borrowed from outside context is a craft/completeness measure.

decisions.name: Tonal Control
decisions.audit_reason: Deliberate tonal balance that reinforces the premise is genuine craft, not surface form.

decisions.name: Diction precision and internal consistency
decisions.audit_reason: Judges precise, consistent word choice and continuity control -- a genuine language-craft skill.

decisions.name: Serial-instalment furniture and pre-assumed world lore
decisions.audit_reason: Explicitly counts markers/names without judging worldbuilding quality; measures serial/platform furniture.

decisions.name: External audience footprint
decisions.audit_reason: Counts links, subreddits, and branding -- platform furniture and promotion, not evidence of craft.

decisions.name: Transcript or log format
decisions.audit_reason: Counts transcript-style conventions without judging effectiveness; a formal fingerprint, not quality.

decisions.name: Markdown vertical-whitespace density
decisions.audit_reason: Pure typographic/whitespace formatting count -- surface form, unrelated to narrative quality.

decisions.name: Copy-editing regularity
decisions.audit_reason: Spelling/grammar/formatting consistency is surface-form mechanics, not evidence of imaginative story quality.

decisions.name: Contest-compliance furniture: word counts and organizer address
decisions.audit_reason: Word-count declarations and organizer addresses are contest-submission furniture, not story quality.

decisions.name: Reader-facing boilerplate
decisions.audit_reason: Author notes, thanks, feedback requests, promo closers are reader-facing platform furniture, not craft.

decisions.name: Novice/non-native authorial disclaimer
decisions.audit_reason: Self-disclosed authorial competence/background is a fingerprint of the writer, not evidence about the story's craft.

decisions.name: First-person pronoun count
decisions.audit_reason: Instruction explicitly ignores narration quality; a pure pronoun frequency count, a surface-form proxy.

decisions.name: Body-part and sensory word count
decisions.audit_reason: Instruction explicitly ignores whether the writing is effective; a pure keyword count, a surface-form proxy.
